description: Create a new object in the user's graph. Use when they ask to add something — a project, note, fact, web link, person, company, product, event, group, tag, or prompt. If an object of the same type and name already exists it is returned instead of duplicated; pass allow_duplicate=true only when the user confirms they want a second one. Set any of the type's own fields at creation with 'fields' (a domain_name's asking_price and source, a contact's phone); a name the type does not have is reported back with the names it accepts. Returns the object with its object_id for follow-up connecting.

allow_duplicate.description: Create even if the same type+name exists.

domain.description: For company objects: the company's website domain (e.g. 'openai.com'). Connects the company to its shared enrichment profile and dedupes per domain.

email.description: For contacts: their email address. Dedupes per address, and fills the address in on a contact of the same name that has none.

fields.description: The type's own fields to set on the new object, e.g. {'asking_price': 75000, 'source': 'GritBrokerage.com'}.

type.description: What kind of object to create.

url.description: Optional URL (the link itself for web_link).

name: create_graph_object
title: Add to brain
